Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all we have from this match. Another loss for Pakistan and now they are staring down to a 5-0 cleansweep. Nothing is going their way in this format and they need a big turnaround in their fortunes. England on the other hand continue to progress under Eoin Morgan and are looking a very formidable side. There is one more ODI left in this series. Do join us on 4th September at 1500 IST (0930 GMT) for the last match in Cardiff. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!!!

Man of the Match, Jonny Bairstow says that unfortunately Buttler missed out today but feels it's part and parcel of the sport. Also says that you just wait for your opportunity and is delighted he played well. Adds that he would like to cement his place in the side. Further adds that with the strength and depth they have got, he just needed to hit the ball and rotate the strike.

Eoin Morgan admits that they were tested today. He praises his bowlers, especially spinners, for restricting Pakistan under 250. Says that the strength of their team is that they bat deep and praises Stokes, Moeen and Bairstow for their knocks, also Root for a good innings at the top. Adds that Bairstow was outstanding today and he is finding it tough to get into a winning side which is a good problem to have. Special mention for Stokes as Morgan says that he showed a lot of character today and he is a naturally aggressive batsman and they don't want to curb that.

Azhar Ali says that it was a bit more competitive game but again they were a few runs short and they didn't have big partnerships. Also says that they lost wickets frequently on a good wicket. He praises Irfan for his brilliant performance in his comeback game but also adds that he was unlucky as he got troubled by his calf and wasn't able to bowl later on. Admits that it's been a difficult series but they are trying and they still need to keep going hard. On his personal performance, he replies that he should have gone on and made a big score for the team.

England are going through a golden period at the moment. Their top four batsmen didn't contribute much today and they were in a stiff situation early on in the chase. But today it was the turn of Ben Stokes and Jonny Bairstow who rose to the occasion. Both played quality knocks and were involved in a match-winning century stand. Moeen Ali towards the end played a responsible innings and made sure that England crossed the finish line without any trouble.

For Pakistan, it was a much better performance. Their bowling with the new ball, especially Mohammad Irfan's opening spell, was very impressive while their fielders were awake in the field tonight. Still there weren't enough runs put on the board which eventually resulted in another defeat. The rest of the bowlers toiled hard but without much success and also the injury to Mohammad Irfan later on didn't help their cause.

Another easy win registered by England as they go 4-0 up in the series. It was yet another excellent performance by the home side as they outplayed Pakistan in all the facets of the game.  Their bowlers were clinical in restricting the visitors to a below par total and then their batsmen after initial hiccups scaled down the target with two overs remaining. The Super Series now stands 16-8!

SIX! Moeen finishes it off in style! Flighted ball on off, Ali shimmies down the track and spanks it over the bowler's head for a maximum. Smiles all over in the English camp as their players jump in joy in the balcony. ENGLAND WIN BY 4 WICKETS!
Quicker ball on off, skidding away, Willey gets back and punches it through extra cover for a couple of runs.
Advances down the track and lofts it over mid on. It goes on one bounce to the fielder in the deep for a single.
Flatter ball on off, defended to the off side.
SIX! Great use of the feet by Moeen as he dances down the track and launches it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Just 4 more needed!
Walks down the track and tucks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Azhar Ali is not happy with his fielder.
Edged but safe! Fullish and outside off, Willey tries to drive it through covers but gets a thick bottom edge behind. It doesn't carry to the keeper.
Identical to the last delivery, another solid defensive shot by David.
Arrows in a fuller length ball on off, Willey gets behind the line and defends it back safely.
On a length and around off, Moeen taps it down to covers for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! Too full in length on middle, Moeen whips it through mid-wicket and the ball screams away to the fence beating the chase from the mid on fielder.
Angles in a full ball around off, Moeen defends it off his front foot.
Hasan Ali back on.
Googly around off, spinning away, Willey tries to push it through the line but misses. Sarfraz collects and puts in an unsuccessful appeal.
Loopy ball on off, Ali gets down the track and knocks it down through mid off for one.
Tossed up ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
Spinning down the leg side, Willey goes back and inside edges his attempted flick shot to fine leg. A single taken.
Floated full ball on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Flatter on middle, punched to mid-wicket for a single.
Moeen shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Fuller in length and outside off, Ali tries to hammer it through covers but it catches the outside edge and goes on one bounce to the wide first slip fielder. He does well to stop it from racing away but cannot prevent the single.
Short ball down the leg side, pulled down to long leg for a single.
Full in length on middle, pushed off the pads to mid-wicket.
David Willey is the new man in, replacing Bairstow.

OUT! Bairstow is run out! Is there a twist in the tale? Full length ball on off, Jonny drives it to mid off and sets off for a quick single. Azhar Ali picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. He appeals and it's referred upstairs. The replays show that Bairstow is inches shot and is out of here. A very good knock by the wicketkeeper batsman. 23 needed off 34 balls.
Appeal for a run out against Bairstow! It's referred upstairs...
50-run stand between Bairstow and Ali.
Back of a length ball around leg, Moeen pulls it down to long leg for a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Offers width outside off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Walks forward and forces it to long on for a run.
Floated on middle, helped through the gap on the leg side for another couple of runs.
Flighted on middle, spinning down, tucked through square leg for a couple of runs.
Azhar Ali to bowl next.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Wide called for height! Gul goes short but it goes way over the head of the batsman.
Short on middle, pulled across the line but straight to the fielder.
Full in length angling into the batsman, Jonny drives it to mid off and scampers across for a quick single. Completes it with ease as Azhar Ali scores a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Short of a length ball on off, Bairstow pulls it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A touch short and around off, Moeen drags it off the inside half of the bat through backward square leg for a single.
Umar Gul is back into the attack. 37 needed off 48 balls.
Gets forward and defends it watchfully to the off side.
A gentle away spin from around off, Jonny gets forward, pushes at it but fails to connect.
Tossed up ball on off, Moeen plays with the spin through mid on for a single.
Floated full on off, driven through mid off for an easy run.
Wide! Quicker one down the leg side, the batsman fails to flick it.
Flatter and shorter on off, Moeen goes back and drags it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted full ball on middle, pushed down through mid off for a single.

Mohammad Irfan runs in and pulls out. He is struggling with his hamstring and is going off the park. Yasir Shah comes as a substitute and jokingly hands his cap to the umpire. No, no you cannot bowl. Meanwhile, it's Imad Wasim to complete the over.
Big wide! A gentle loosener by Irfan, way wide outside off, almost on the unused pitch adjacent to the main pitch. An easy leave and the umpire stretches his arms.
Mohammad Irfan is unleashed back into the attack.
Full on middle, pushed to mid on. Dot ball to end the over.
In the air...safe! Full length ball angling into the batsman, Moeen hits it through the line, it's aerial and just clears Azhar Ali at mid off. A couple of runs taken.
Fullish and angling in, Moeen drives it off his front foot past the bowler who tries to stop it with his right boot. He fails to do so but the mid off has it covered.
Lands it full on off, it's driven to covers where the fielder misfields and they steal a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Hasan steams in from round the wicket and arrows in a very full ball on off, Moeen digs it out to the off side.
Powerplay 3 signalled. 5 fielder are now allowed outside the circle.
Comes down the track and mistimes his lofted shot over covers for a single.
Loopy and around off, Bairstow drives it with the spin through cover-point for one.
Flighted on off, tapped to covers, Moeen wanted a run but was sent back.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on off, Moeen attempts to play the reverse batted shot but it comes off his gloves and rolls wide of short third man. A single taken.
Advances down the track and flicks it with the spin to the leg side.
Lands it full and outside off, Bairstow drives it to mid off.
Full in length outside off, Moeen drives it square of the wicket, a shade uppish but through the gap, a single taken.
Length around off, tapped down point.
Full and outside off, Moeen presents a straight bat and pushes it to mid off.
Angles across a full length ball outside off, Ali drives it off his front foot to point.
Quick single. Fuller in length on off, Bairstow drives it to mid off and sprints to the other end. The fielder has a shy but misses otherwise it would have been touch and go.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.
Shortish ball outside off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Leg bye! Spinning down from around middle, Moeen tries to flick and it comes off his thigh pads to square leg for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Ali has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter arm ball outside off, tapped to point for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, played off the pads to mid-wicket.
2nd ODI fifty for Jonny Bairstow!

FOUR! A cracking shot down the ground to reach his fifty. Another valuable knock by Jonny when the chips were down. Tossed up ball on middle, Bairstow hurries down the track and rockets it straight down the ground for a boundary. Boom she goes!
Around off, it's an arm ball, Bairstow punches it through extra cover for a single.
Beautifully bowled, drifting in and spinning away a bit, Jonny tries to heave across the line but misses.
Moeen has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Flatter again, on off, punched to long off for one.
Flatter and on off, Ali tries to flick with the spin but it skids on to take the leading edge. Goes safely to the off side.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. One run added to the total.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side but finds the fielder.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortish on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Moeen has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Goes on the back foot and punches it through covers for a single.
Nawaz back on.
Spinning back into the batsman from outside off, Moeen keeps it out off the inside part of the bat to square leg.
Loopy ball on off, spinning in, Moeen gets forward and defends it down.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
EDGY FOUR! A quicker arm ball on off, Bairstow goes back to cut but it takes the outside edge and beats Sarfraz's gloves to the fence at third man.
Bowls it with a quicker arm action and lands it full outside off, Moeen pushes it off his front foot through covers and gets off the mark with a single.
Moeen Ali is the new man in, replacing Stokes.

OUT! Stokes holes out! Flighted full ball on off, Stokes goes down on one knee and slogs it over mid-wicket. However, he fails to middle it and it goes off the bottom half of the bat. The ball balloons in the air and falls straight down the throat of Babar Azam in the deep. Picked the fielder to precision. End of a good knock by Ben and Imad Wasim is all pumped up. 73 needed off 95 balls.
Bouncer around off, Bairstow sways away from the line.
Hits a very full length around off, Stokes digs it out to mid off scampers across for a quick single.
Gul aims for a yorker but ends up slipping a full toss on middle, Jonny works it through square leg for a single.
Shortish again, around off, Ben pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Stokes punches it from the crease to cover-point.
Full length ball angling into the batsman from round the wicket, Stokes defends it off his back foot.
Serves it on the pads, Bairstow flicks it to the leg side off his pads.
Bowls it full on off, defended off the front foot.
Darts it outside off, a play and a miss.
Beaten! Tossed up ball around off, Bairstow looks to run that fine but is beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
100-run stand between Stokes and Bairstow.
Full on off, played to point for a single.
Drinks break...
Full in length and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fuller and on off, Stokes goes hard at it and gets it off from the bottom part of the bat. Straight to mid off.
Appeal for an lbw as Bairstow fails to flick it on the leg side. They cross for a leg bye. Probably, the impact was outside off.
Good stop by Azhar Ali! Full in length and wide outside off, Stokes reaches out for it and drills it to mid off. Ali dives and saves a certain boundary. They pick up a single.
Fuller in length and around off, Stokes gets forward and drives it down to mid on.
Umar Gul is back on.
Flighted on off, pushed back to the bowler to end the over.
Slow and outside off, cut through point for a couple of runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and on off, knocked down to long on for one.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Flighted ball on off, Stokes goes down on one knee to slog but misses. It goes very closely past the off stump and the keeper fumbles. They cross and it's given as a run. Hmm... so there was some bottom edge over it and hence it will go down as a dropped chance.
Imad Wasim is back on.
Tossed up ball on off, Bairstow comes to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads, played to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Slapped! Short ball on middle, Stokes slog sweeps it through deep mid-wicket for a well-placed boundary.
SIX! Downtown! Darts it outside off, Stokes kneels and deposits it to long on for a biggie. Ben is in a hurry for a chase now. The partnership moves to 86 now.
Serves it on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
On the pads, tucked to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Stokes lets it through.
Full ball on off, Stokes strides forward and blocks it.
Length ball on off, driven through covers for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short ball on middle and leg, Bairstow sees the length early and slams it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Wide! Quicker one down the leg side, Stokes tries to flick but misses.
5th ODI fifty for Ben Stokes!
Flatter and shorter around off, Stokes goes back and punches it through covers for a couple of runs. Fifty from the bat of Stokes and it's a vital knock.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it through cover-point for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Bairstow gets on the front foot and defends it back to the bowler.
Walks down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Too full in length on off, Stokes digs it out firmly to mid-wicket where the fielder dives to make the half stop. A single taken.
Mohammad Nawaz is back on.
Another short ball on off, Bairstow is once again early into the pull shot and gets an inside edge onto the body.
Pitches it full and on off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
Short of a length ball on off, Jonny is early into the pull shot and hence fails to make any connection.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
The only slip moves to mid-wicket.
FOUR! A shade over-pitched and outside off, Bairstow gets on the front foot and bludgeons it through covers for a cracking boundary.

Back of a length ball on off, Bairstow punches it through covers and it races through. Yasir (sub) runs across to his right in the deep and slides to make an excellent stop. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Lunges to a full ball and drives it to covers. The fielder misfields and allows a single.
Short and on off, Bairstow goes back to punch but once again finds the cover fielder.
Flatter on off, punched to covers.
Too full in length on off, Jonny drives it to extra cover.
Shortish on off, cut through point for a single.
Flighted ball on off, quietly played on the off side for a quick single.
Full in length and around off, Stokes walks forward a bit and defends it back.
Full length ball on middle and off, Stokes gets forward to cover the line and defends it with a straight bat to the leg side.
On a length and outside off, left alone.
Shortish on middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball on off, punched through extra cover for a single.

Mohammad Irfan gets ready to bowl but hang on, he is going off the field. Maybe, something wrong. We will let you know the issue as soon as we get the update.Mohammad Amir comes as a substitute.  Meanwhile, Hasan Ali is brought back into the attack.

FOUR! Superb shot! Nawaz tosses it up in the air and lands it full outside off, Stokes strides forward and creams it through extra cover for a boundary. The mid off fielder gives it the chase but fails to cut it off near the fence with a slide. Stokes is motoring.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. No run.
Flatter and on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Quicker one on the pads, Stokes fails to put it away.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to mid on.
50-run stand between Stokes and Bairstow.
FOUR! Great shot! Nawaz is on the shorter side and lands it around middle, Stokes goes deep inside the crease and nails his pull shot to the deep square leg fence.

NOT OUT! A touch short in length and around off, Stokes plays a late cut towards backward point and calls his partner through for a quick single. There is a direct hit at the striker's end and it's referred upstairs. The replays show that Jonny is safely in.
Appeal for a run out against Bairstow is referred upstairs...
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Kneels down and sweeps it towards short fine leg where the fielder makes a diving stop. A single taken.

DROPPED BY NAWAZ! Shortish and around off, Stokes goes deep inside the crease and booms it over square leg. Nawaz in the deep reacts quickly, dives forward but spills the chance. It was swirling in the air and was a very tough chance. Good attempt by the fielder and he did well to not concede a boundary. Only a single.
Flatter ball on off, spinning in, Stokes punches it back to the bowler who fumbles but still does well to parry it towards mid off.
Tossed up ball on off, Jonny gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Gets back and punches it back to the bowler.
SIX! Magnificent use of the feet by Bairstow, he shimmies down to the pitch of the ball and lofts it nonchalantly down the ground for a biggie.
Flighted full ball on off, knocked down to long on for a single.
Shortish on off, punched off the back foot to point for a single.
Full ball on off, an arm ball, Bairstow gets forward to drive it through mid off but it comes off the inside part of the bat and rolls past the bowler through mid on for a single.
Nicely tossed up ball on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to Azhar Ali at short mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, it's punched down to long on for another run.
Another flighted ball on off, pushed down to long off for an easy single.
Flighted ball on off, turning in, Stokes goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Appeal for an lbw! Full floated ball landing around off, spinning in after pitching, Stokes tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal as the batsmen cross. It's given as a leg bye. Maybe, spinning too much and would have missed leg. The replays show that the impact was with the umpire's call.
Arm ball outside off, Stokes goes back to play the cut shot but fails to make any connection.
Strides forward and pushes it through the gap at covers for a couple of runs. 100 up for England!
Loopy ball on off, Stokes tries to reverse sweep but fails to make any connection. It goes off his pads to short third man.
Spinning back into the batsman from around off, a touch short in length, Stokes goes back and keeps it out off the inside half of the bat.
Flighted ball on off, flicked off the pads to mid-wicket.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot to the point region.
Gets forward to a full ball and forces it through mid off for a single.
Wide! Fires a shorter one down the leg side, Stokes tries his best to pull but misses. Sarfraz does well to stop it.
SIX! Boom! Wasim tosses it up and serves a full ball on off, Stokes jumps down to the pitch of the delivery and pumps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flatter ball on off, punched off the back foot to mid off.
Gets on the front foot and drives it with the spin through covers for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back to the bowler.
Imad Wasim is back on.
Flicks it across the line by coming down the track but plays it straight to mid-wicket.
Shortish on off, Stokes goes back and punches it straight to the short cover fielder.
Quicker arm ball on off, Bairstow tucks it off the inside part of the bat to backward square leg. A single taken.
Flighted ball around leg, Bairstow tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It comes off the leading edge and goes back to the bowler.
A touch short and on off, Stokes pulls it across the line and the short mid-wicket fielder makes a half stop as he dives to his right. A single taken.
Flatter and shorter around off, Bairstow goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz is introduced into the attack.
An over-pitched ball on off, it's driven off the front foot through covers for a single.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Stokes slaps it through covers for a single.
Good length ball angling into the batsman from round the wicket, Stokes tries to defend from the crease but it takes the outside half of the bat and rolls to point.
Lovely timing! Back of a length ball on off, Stokes hammers it across the line and it races past mid on. It's fielder in the deep by the mid-wicket fielder and they take a couple of runs.
Oohhh...nearly drags it on! A length ball on off, Bairstow tries to swing it across the line but it catches the inside edge, thuds on his pads and runs away to fine leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Bairstow defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Full and angling into the batsman, Stokes gets forward with a straight bat and defends it back to the bowler.
Hasan is forced to change his angle and he comes from round the wicket. Bowls it on a length and outside off, Stokes lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Carbon copy of the last shot! Once again it's in the slot for Ben and he strokes it through the line. Just wide of mid off and another boundary down the ground.
FOUR! That's a strong shot! An over-pitched ball around off, Stokes gets on the front foot and drills it straight down the ground for a boundary.

Bairstow gets off the mark but not in a convincing manner. Length ball around off, nipping in a bit, Bairstow tries to play it straight but it takes the inside edge and rolls in front of mid on. They cross for a brisk single.
Not in control there. Full length ball in the line of the stumps, Stokes tries to flick it through mid-wicket but it comes off the inside edge and runs down to fine leg for a run.
A wayward bouncer, wide outside off, an easy leave for Jonny.
Identical to the last delivery but it's bowled closer to the off stump line this time, Bairstow is forced to play and he does well to defend it solidly with a straight bat.
Good line to the new batsman, it's on a fuller length and just outside off, holding its line, Bairstow shows that he knows his off stump as he lets it through to the keeper after covering the line.
Jonny Bairstow walks in next. This is his first match of the series but he showed tremendous form in the Test series. England need him now, can he deliver in coloured clothes?

OUT! Morgan departs and it's a body blow to England! Gul angles across a shortish ball on off, Morgan tries to run it down to third man but it's not a smart choice with a wide first slip in place. A little error from the English captain as he takes the outer half of the bat and Pakistan have been neat in the field today. A good catch by Sharjeel Khan and England are four down. 176 needed off 213 balls.
Another back of a length ball on off, this time Stokes pulls it across the line through square leg and by the time it's stopped in the deep, they take a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Morgan easily turns it through the gap at square leg and picks up a single.
Umar Gul comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Poor line and duly punished! Hasan bowls it wide outside off and it's a touch on the shorter side, Stokes latches onto the room and whacks it through the gap at cover-point for a boundary.
Too straight in line, Stokes works it through square leg and gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
On a length and around middle, Ben brings down a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
Bangs in a short ball on off, Morgan goes for the pull shot, doesn't middle it but still it goes wide of the mid on fielder. He makes a tumbling stop which allows the batsmen to cross for a run.
Good length ball on off, Morgan walks forward and across a bit and defends it down.
Fuller length ball around leg, good pace, Morgan defends it off his pads to the bowler. Hasan picks it up and has a shy at the striker's end. Good intent shown by Pakistan today in the field.
This one is quicker through the air, on middle, Stokes does well to keep it out towards mid-wicket. Tidy over!
Loopy ball around off, Stokes gets on the front foot and dead bats it on the off side.
On the pads this time, Stokes works it across the line but finds mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler by Stokes.
Flighted on middle, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Walks down to flick it but it takes the outer half of the bat and rolls past short third man for a couple of runs.
Width on offer outside off, Morgan throws his bat at it and the outside edge runs down to third man for a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Sharp delivery, on a length and around middle, Morgan is beaten for pace and is hit on the thigh pad.
Lands it full and outside off, Morgan drives it to mid off.
Ben Stokes is the new batsman.

OUT! That's a prized wicket, Root is out of here! Big, big breakthrough for Pakistan. Hasan digs in a short ball around off, Root top edges his attempted pull shot and big Irfan settles underneath it to take the catch safely. Hasan raises his arms in celebration. A rare failure for Root and let's see how the English middle order responds now. 189 needed off 232 balls.
On a length and outside off, Root gets across the stumps and pushes it straight to mid off.
Morgan has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted and full outside off, driven easily through mid off for a single.
Quicker one fired on the pads, it's eased to square leg for one.
Another front foot drive by Morgan but this time it's not timed well. The ball goes past extra cover but the mid off fielder fields it.
5000 ODI runs for Eoin Morgan.
FOUR! Shot! Wasim gives this one some extra flight but pitches it very full outside off, Morgan gets forward and drives it crisply through extra cover for a boundary.
Flatter ball on middle, flicked through square leg for a single.
Imad Wasim to bowl next.
Powerplay 2 is taken. Four fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Bowls it full and outside off, it's pushed off the front foot to covers.
Too straight in line this time, Root nudges it fine down the leg side for a run.

Good comeback delivery by Ali, he ups his pace a bit and angles in a full ball around off, Root tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. The ball catches the leading edge and rolls to point.
FOUR! Even better! Ali alters his length and goes full around off, Root leans forward and across stylishly and flicks it through mid-wicket for back-to-back boundaries.

FOUR! Great shot from a batsman in ruthless form! Just a shade short in length and around middle, Root picks up the length in a trice, goes deep inside the crease and thumps it via a pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence. 3000 ODI runs for Root!
Starts with a fuller length ball on off, Root drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Hasan Ali to bowl next.
Full ball on off, defended beautifully. What an over this has been.
The batsman tries hooking that one but misses it completely.
Length ball outside off, a play and a miss.

Not out! Length ball around off, Morgan off his back foot is squared up and the ball passes his bat and pad. Sarfraz collects the ball and goes up for a caught behind appeal. The appeal is turned down but Pakistan reviews it. The Snickometer detects nothing and the noise was of the ball brushing the shirt. The decision stays and Morgan will continue to bat. Pakistan lose their only review.
Morgan is not given caught behind but Pakistan takes a review.
Wide! Short ball on middle and leg, Morgan looks to pull that but misses the line of the ball. Half-hearted appeal is turned down.
Full ball on middle and leg, it hits the pads.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full ball on off, blocked neatly.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
That was close! Short ball on middle and leg, Root tries to pull it but misses. It looked like as if Root got a nick but there was none.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
SIX! Pulled away! Short ball on middle and leg, Root stays deep in his crease and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Full ball around off, blocked neatly.
Peach! Length ball outside off, a play and a miss.
Short ball on middle and leg, Morgan fends it to the leg side.
Short leg in place for Morgan.
Eoin Morgan is the new man in.

OUT! Yes, he does! Hurls a length ball from around the wicket, the reason to bowl from this side was because of his warnings and it did wonders. Coming to the ball it was a length ball outside off, Hales off his front foot tries to block that but the away shape of the ball takes a nick and Sarfraz takes the catch with glee. Irfan is in a rampage celebration. England lose both their openers.

Just short! Pitches it up outside off, Hales gets a nick off his front foot. The ball falls just short of second slip. Hales survives. Irfan is generating some contest from that angle around the stumps, can he pick up another wicket?
Full ball on off, cut to point.
Irfan hurls a length ball from around the wicket, Hales pushes it to mid off.
Pitches it full around off, Joe drives it to covers. Good comeback from Gul after taking some beating up the over.
Slants in a length ball on off, it goes on to thud into the pads via inside edge.
Hurls it full on middle and off, it stays low and Root blocks it.
Length ball on off, punched back to Gul.

FOUR! Glorious! Good length ball on middle and off, Root plays a better shot by pushing it through the line. The ball off Gul's hand goes down through mid on for a boundary. Joe is showcasing some brilliance with his bat.
Fires in a length ball, it stays a bit low and Root off his back foot does well to defend that.
Meanwhile, Mohammad Irfan who was already been warned once for stepping on the danger zone is now warned for the second time. If he steps there again, he would be not allowed to bowl further.
Serves it full on off, defended off his front foot.
Serves it wide outside off, Hales lets it through and has a look at the umpire. Again a wide is not given.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Root chips it to square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, moving away from Root and he lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Short length ball outside off, Root off his back foot punches it and the ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a boundary.
Full ball on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
Short ball outside off, Hales withdraws his shot at the last minute. End of an over.
Back of a length ball on off, tapped to point.
FOUR! Classic! Bowls it on off, width on offer, the kind of form Hales is in, will put anything and everything away. It is carved through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! That sound off the bat says it all! Angles in a full ball, Hales stays in his crease and sends the ball down the ground through mid off for a boundary.
Pitches it up around off, driven to covers.
Full ball on off, cut to point.
FOUR! Serves it short and wide outside off, Root cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Joe Root is the new man, replacing Roy.

OUT! Irfan has the last laugh! Pitches it touch short around off, Roy off his back foot is squared up and ends up nicking it. Rizwan at second slip dives to his left and takes a brilliant catch. Irfan is all pumped up and so is Rizwan. England lose their first wicket. The dangerman departs.
FOUR! Two in two! Pitches it up around off, Roy plays it away from his body through extra cover for boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short ball around off, Roy off his back foot pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length ball around off, Roy blocks it.
Bowls a length ball outside off, inviting the batsman for a drive and beats him. Almost a nick there.
Pitches it up around off, Hales pushes it to covers. A maiden for Gul to start with.
Slants a length ball on middle and leg, Hales is cramped up on his back foot. The ball hits high on his thigh pads and it falls on the track.
Fires a length ball outside off, it holds its line. Hales respects the ball and leaves it for the keeper.
Full ball on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Pitches it full on middle and leg, Hales with the full face of the bat pushes it. The ball goes of the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Full ball on middle and leg, Hales pushes it to mid on for no runs.
Umar Gul to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
FOUR! Cracked away! Back of a length ball outside off, Jason Roy stays back and crashes it through covers for a boundary.
Short ball on off, cut to point.
Back of a length ball around off, Roy looks to slam that away but misses the line of the ball completely.
Full ball on off, defended off his front foot.
Length ball outside off, width on offer too. Roy leaves it for the keeper.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Roy tucks it to the leg side for a brace.
Wide! Hurls wide outside off, Roy lets it through. The umpire gives it a wide. England off the mark.
We are back for the chase! Alex Hales and Jason Roy are the two English openers. Mohammad Irfan to start first up. Here we go...
